subject: Thermostat acting up again
text:
Hi there,

hope you’re doing well. I’m feeling a bit silly asking, but I ran into an odd problem with the smart thermostat you installed last month and I’m not sure if it’s me or something on your end. The schedule keeps resetting to the old morning temperatures, even after I change them twice and wait overnight. It also blinks at me whenever I press the hold button, and my phone app shows it offline for a few seconds then reconnects. The upstairs vent also started making a quiet clicking sound around bedtime, which didn’t happen during the installation visit. That’s probably unrelated, I hope. But I’d feel better if you heard it too. I’ve tried rebooting the router, checking the panel display, and swapping out the batteries in the wall hub because that seemed obvious enough, but nothing has stuck.

I’m worried it might need a firmware update or a small part replacement, and I want to make sure I’m not charged for something that wasn’t caused by my settings. If this turns into an unexpected expense, could you let me know before sending someone? I really appreciate your patience while I sort this out; the weather has made the whole thing more urgent than I expected, but I’d rather understand the issue first than have it fixed twice.
